name: Finn-loop
description: Three complementary agent skills for interactive Linear specification, approved issue implementation and exact-head GitHub PR review, with human merge authority.

metadata.github_description: The Finn-loop: a 3-skill AI software factory for Claude Code — spec, build, review. Humans merge.

SKILL.lean_review_note: All three skills are separate reusable roles: interactive specification, issue implementation and exact-head PR review. The validation script and CI enforce this package's text conventions, so they are maintenance dependencies rather than independent capabilities. These are host-executed instructions, not a server implementing a distributed lock or merge authorization.

deep_review.conclusion: The instruction contracts separate human specification/agent-ready authorization from builder mutations and review evidence. Builder requires a clean tree and warns its issue assignment is not an atomic same-user lock. Reviewer checks current required CI and rechecks head before posting; neither role merges or enables auto-merge. Linear TEAM/labels and host credentials require configuration. Catalog review establishes the workflow and limits; it did not invoke the skills, issue trackers, Git writes or PR comments.

important_subsystems.name: issue specification
important_subsystems.purpose: Research and draft acceptance/non-goal issue contracts with human decisions.

important_subsystems.purpose: Claim an authorized issue, implement its contract, verify and open a PR.

important_subsystems.purpose: Review exact-head code/check evidence and post a structured verdict without merging.
